title: Rotterdam dockworkers union sets 8-day strike from August 14
body: FNV Havens, the union representing container terminal workers at the Port of Rotterdam, has confirmed an eight-day strike action beginning 14 August 2026 and running through 22 August. The action covers the Maasvlakte II, Euromax and Delta terminals, which together handle the majority of deepsea container volumes at the port. Union negotiators said talks over the 2026-2027 collective labour agreement collapsed on 9 August over inflation-linked wage indexation. Terminal operators warned that gate operations and vessel handling would be reduced to skeleton crews for the duration.

title: Carriers begin omitting Rotterdam calls as strike window nears
body: At least three alliance services on the Asia-North Europe trade have filed schedule changes that omit Rotterdam and discharge at Antwerp or Hamburg instead, according to filings seen this week. Port authority data show 11 vessels currently at anchor awaiting berth, up from a typical three to four. Terminal operators estimate handling capacity during the action will fall to roughly 25 percent of normal, and expect a recovery backlog of one to two weeks after the strike ends. Shippers with time-sensitive cargo have been advised to review transhipment alternatives immediately.

title: Dutch mediator steps in as Rotterdam port strike enters final preparations
body: A government-appointed mediator has been asked to restart talks between FNV Havens and the Rotterdam terminal employers association, two people familiar with the matter said. Neither side has withdrawn from the planned 14 August action, and the union said preparations continue. Analysts said even a settlement in the coming days would leave a congestion overhang, as vessel bunching and yard density at Maasvlakte are already elevated. Hinterland barge and rail operators reported slot shortages into Germany for the second half of August.

title: Suez Canal transit waiting times lengthen as convoy scheduling tightens
body: Average waiting time for northbound convoys at Suez rose to 3.4 days last week from 1.9 days in July, canal agents reported. The Suez Canal Authority attributed the increase to a temporary reduction in convoy slots during dredging work in the Great Bitter Lake section. Liner operators on the Asia-Europe trade said the additional dwell is being absorbed into schedules for now but warned that combined with any North European port disruption, cumulative delay could exceed a week.

title: Asia-Europe schedule reliability slips to 61 percent in July
body: Schedule reliability on the Asia-North Europe corridor fell to 61 percent in July from 68 percent in June, with average delay for late vessel arrivals at 5.2 days. Analysts pointed to accumulated Suez waiting time and berth congestion at several North European hubs. Carriers have added blank sailings for weeks 34 and 35 to reset rotations.

title: Typhoon warning issued for Yangtze delta; Shanghai port braces for closure
body: China's National Meteorological Centre issued an orange typhoon warning as Typhoon Nari approaches the Yangtze River delta, with landfall expected between 12 and 13 August. Shanghai Port Group said container terminals at Yangshan and Waigaoqiao would suspend operations for an estimated 24 to 36 hours during the passage. Vessels have been instructed to leave berths and seek shelter. Historical closures of similar duration have produced three to five days of recovery backlog.

title: Shanghai terminals resume partial operations after typhoon passage
body: Yangshan Deepwater Port resumed limited gate operations on the afternoon of 13 August after Typhoon Nari weakened to a tropical storm. Terminal operators reported no structural damage but a queue of 40 vessels awaiting berth. Full recovery of the berthing schedule is expected within four days. Transhipment cargo routed through Shanghai may see additional connection delays.

title: 국내 완성차 3사, 7월 내수 판매 전년 대비 4.2% 증가
body: 국내 완성차 3사의 7월 내수 판매가 전년 동월 대비 4.2% 증가한 것으로 집계됐다. 친환경차 비중이 처음으로 40%를 넘어섰으며, 업계는 하반기 신차 출시 효과가 이어질 것으로 전망했다. 다만 원자재 가격 상승과 인건비 부담이 수익성에 영향을 줄 수 있다는 분석도 나온다.

title: European Central Bank holds rates steady, signals patience on cuts
body: The European Central Bank left its key policy rate unchanged at its August meeting, saying it needed more evidence that services inflation was on a sustained downward path. Markets had broadly expected the decision. The euro was little changed against the dollar following the announcement.

title: Enterprise software startup raises 120 million dollars in Series C
body: A workflow automation startup announced a 120 million dollar Series C round led by an existing investor, valuing the company at 1.4 billion dollars. The company said the funds would go toward expanding its engineering team and entering the European market next year.

title: Netherlands secures qualification with late winner in Amsterdam
body: A stoppage-time goal at the Johan Cruyff Arena sealed qualification for the Dutch national side. The manager praised the squad's resilience after a difficult first half. Around 52,000 spectators attended the match.

title: Researchers report improved catalyst for green hydrogen electrolysis
body: A research group has reported a nickel-iron catalyst that reduces the overpotential required for oxygen evolution in alkaline electrolysers. The team said durability testing over 2,000 hours showed limited degradation. Commercial deployment remains several years away.

title: 서울시, 도심 자율주행 버스 시범 노선 확대
body: 서울시가 도심 자율주행 버스 시범 운행 노선을 기존 2개에서 5개로 확대한다고 밝혔다. 야간 운행 구간도 포함되며, 안전요원이 탑승한 상태로 운행된다. 시는 내년까지 이용 데이터를 축적해 정식 노선 전환 여부를 검토할 계획이다.

title: Heatwave prompts health advisories across southern Europe
body: Temperatures exceeded 40C in parts of Spain and southern Italy this week, prompting health authorities to issue advisories for vulnerable groups. Meteorologists said the heat dome was expected to weaken by the weekend.

title: Summer box office rebounds on strong animated releases
body: Domestic box office receipts for July came in 12 percent above the same month last year, driven by two animated titles that each crossed 300 million dollars worldwide. Studio executives said the slate for the autumn remains crowded.

title: Semiconductor equipment orders rise on memory capacity expansion
body: Orders for wafer fabrication equipment rose 9 percent quarter on quarter as memory makers restarted capacity expansion plans. Equipment vendors said lead times for lithography tools remain extended into next year.

title: 국민연금, 해외 대체투자 비중 확대 방침 발표
body: 국민연금공단이 해외 대체투자 비중을 단계적으로 확대하겠다는 중기 자산배분 방침을 발표했다. 인프라와 사모대출 비중을 늘리고 국내 채권 비중은 소폭 축소할 계획이다.

title: Global coffee prices ease as Brazilian harvest outlook improves
body: Arabica futures fell for a third session as forecasters raised estimates for the Brazilian crop. Traders said improved rainfall in Minas Gerais had reduced concerns about bean size. Roasters have been slow to pass through earlier increases to retail prices.

title: New wearable adds continuous sleep staging to consumer devices
body: A consumer electronics maker introduced a wearable that performs continuous sleep staging using a combination of accelerometer and photoplethysmography signals. Independent validation against polysomnography has not yet been published.

title: 프로야구 관중 800만 돌파, 역대 최다 기록 경신
body: 올 시즌 프로야구 누적 관중이 800만 명을 돌파하며 역대 최다 기록을 경신했다. 구단들은 어린이 팬 유입과 주중 경기 관중 증가를 주요 요인으로 꼽았다.
